title: Interviewer Calibration Bootcamp - 30 Day Syllabus (WIP)
summary: 30-day practical syllabus to rapidly align interviewers across teams on rubric use, question design, bias mitigation, and scoring consistency. Designed for hiring managers, designated interviewers, and new ICs who will participate in hiring at Redwood Inference.
goals: (1) Achieve consistent application of the interviewer rubric across Eng/Product/Research; (2) Reduce inter-interviewer variance in scores by 30% on calibrated sets within 60 days; (3) Equip interviewers with concrete question templates and follow-up probes for role-level competencies; (4) Surface and remediate common bias patterns observed in live interviews.
duration_and_format: 30 calendar days; mix of asynchronous modules, twice-weekly 60-90m facilitator-led sessions, three live calibration panels with recorded mock interviews. Completion badge awarded after passing a 2-interviewer live calibration check.
week_1_objectives: Foundations: rubric walk-through, behavioral vs technical question framing, legal/compliance redlines, note-taking standards. Deliverable: annotated rubric examples (3 hires) and one short practice interview recorded.
week_2_objectives: Role-specific deep dives: core competency mapping for Eng-Serving-Runtime, Product, Applied-ML. Build a 4-question interview for your role with clear scoring anchors. Deliverable: question bank submission and peer feedback.
week_3_objectives: Bias mitigation and evidence-based scoring: unconscious bias primer, micro-inequity examples from past hiring notes, how to translate qualitative answers into rubric-aligned evidence. Deliverable: redaction exercise and re-scoring of two anonymized interview transcripts.
week_4_objectives: Calibration panels and live assessments: two live panels (cross-functional) apply rubric to recorded interviews, discuss divergences; final live pair interview where trainee acts as primary interviewer and is scored by trainer. Deliverable: pass/fail calibration check and improvement plan if needed.
sample_session_agenda: (60m) 5m intro & objective, 10m concept review, 20m active exercise (mock interview or redaction), 15m scoring & discussion, 10m action items and resources.
training_materials: slide-deck: interviewer-basics-v3.pdf, recorded-mocks/ (internal drive), question-bank-template.xlsx, rubric-v2-clean.docx, bias-mitigation-handout.pdf
assessment_rubric: Score each competency 1-4 with evidence sentence required for any score >=3. Competencies: problem-solving, system-design (if applicable), collaboration & communication, role-knowledge, ownership, quality of tradeoffs. Passing threshold: average >=3 across competencies and no competency with '1'.
mock_interview_examples: 2 short mocks (10m each) for initial practice; 1 long mock (30m) used for final calibration. Mocks include: follow-up probes, time-boxed debugging, and a short architecture whiteboard prompt (as text).
common_mistakes_observed: over-scoring 'culture fit' without evidence, asking leading questions, inconsistent follow-up across candidates, conflating seniority with visibility in prior orgs, lax note-taking that omits concrete evidence.
trainer_notes: Encourage explicit evidence statements: write the sentence a candidate would say that maps to a rubric item. For panel discussions, call out anchor answers early and save time by marking 'disagree/agree' lanes quickly. Keep calibration sessions under 75 minutes.
practical_checklist: Record two practice interviews and upload to mocks folder
Attend at least two live calibration panels
Pass live pair calibration or schedule remediation within 14 days
Apply redaction exercise to two historical notes and submit before Day 20
follow_up_plan: Monthly 45m refreshers for the first 3 months post-bootcamp; quarterly blind re-calibrations using anonymized transcripts; hiring-manager quarterly review to spot distortions in score distributions.
remediation_path: If trainee fails calibration: 1) targeted 1:1 with trainer (30-60m), 2) paired shadow interviews for 2 hires, 3) re-assessment panel. Documented improvement required within 30 days.
metrics_and_success_criteria: inter-interviewer variance reduction (target -30% in mean absolute difference), rubric coverage (>=95% of hires have full competency coverage in notes), pass-rate for new interviewers (target 85% by cohort end).
next_steps_for_people_ops: Schedule cohort #1 with Eng-Serving-Runtime and Applied-ML; finalize trainer roster (Rina/Tom/Miguel); get legal sign-off on training materials; prepare comms for hiring-managers and include in new-hire onboarding checklist.
notes_to_self: WIP: tighten the passing threshold language; add explicit cross-team examples for PM vs Eng vs ML researcher interviews; collect representative candidate transcripts from last 12 months for anonymized calibration bank.
